form.isPublic: Visible on the public status page
form.slugHelp: Used in public URLs. Leave empty to generate it from the name.

copy.manual: Copying is not available here. The text is selected, copy it manually.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Current state of your status page at a glance.
dashboard.noFailingSources: All monitoring sources are polled successfully.
dashboard.failingSourcesCount_one: {{count}} monitoring source is failing. Ask an administrator for details.
dashboard.failingSourcesCount_other: {{count}} monitoring sources are failing. Ask an administrator for details.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.description: Report outages and keep customers informed with updates.
incidents.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Increased error rates for the API
incidents.impactHelp: Overall severity shown on the incident.
incidents.messageHelp: First public update. Keep it short and factual.
incidents.publicHelp: Hidden incidents are only visible here and do not change public service statuses.
incidents.affectedServicesHelp: Pick the services and how badly each one is affected. The worst status wins on the public page.
incidents.affectedLocationsHelp: Optional: data center locations related to this incident.
incidents.resolveHelp: Posting a "Resolved" update closes the incident.
incidents.adjustServicesHelp: Replace the affected services with this update (e.g. when the impact changes).
incidents.deleteUpdateConfirm: Delete this update? This cannot be undone.
incidents.lastUpdateHint: An incident needs at least one update.
incidents.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{title}}" with all updates? It disappears from the public history. This cannot be undone.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Announce planned work so customers can prepare.
maintenance.descriptionHelp: Public description: what happens and what customers should expect.
maintenance.autoStartHelp: Switches to "In progress" at the scheduled start.
maintenance.autoCompleteHelp: Switches to "Completed" at the scheduled end.
maintenance.publicHelp: Hidden maintenance is only visible here and does not change public service statuses.
maintenance.servicesHelp: These services show "Maintenance" while the window is in progress.
maintenance.statusHelp: Posting an update also sets the maintenance to this status.
maintenance.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{title}}" with all updates? This cannot be undone.

retroactiveHint.past: This window is already over. It is recorded as completed, no email is sent, and its time counts as maintenance (not as downtime) in the uptime history.
retroactiveHint.started: This window has already started. It starts right away; subscribers only get the "in progress" email (no announcement), and the time since the start counts as maintenance in the uptime history.
retroactiveHint.hidden: Note: a hidden maintenance does not change statuses, so it does not correct the uptime history. Use a status correction with the status "Maintenance" for an internal window.

corrections.title: Corrections
corrections.description: Fix the uptime history afterwards, e.g. a false alarm or an outage the monitoring missed. The measured data is kept; corrections are applied on top and can be edited or deleted at any time.
corrections.deleteConfirm: Delete this correction? The uptime history shows the measured data again for this range.
corrections.dialogIntro: The selected services get this status for the time range. Where corrections overlap, the one created last wins. A forgotten maintenance is better entered as maintenance with its real window.
corrections.statusHelp: "Operational" marks a false alarm; an outage status records a missed outage.
corrections.reasonHelp: Internal, never shown publicly. Also recorded in the audit log.
corrections.showPublicHelp: Days containing this correction are marked "corrected afterwards" on the public status page.
corrections.publicNoteHelp: Optional. Shown with the marker, e.g. "False alarm of the monitoring system."

fields.showPublic: Show a note on the public page

compare.title: History: measured and corrected
compare.intro: Compares the measured status history with the history after corrections and retroactive maintenance. Uptime counts degraded performance and maintenance as up.

services.title: Services & sites
services.description: Public services and websites, built from internal monitoring checks.
services.empty: No services yet. Create your first service and link monitoring checks to it.
services.builderIntro: Combine internal checks into one public service. Customers only see the resulting status.
services.kindHelp: Sites are websites with a public URL; services are everything else.
services.urlHelp: Shown as a link on the status page.
services.publicHelp: Hidden services are only visible in the management area.
services.locationsHelp: Data center locations where this service runs. Its status counts towards these locations.
services.statusIntro: How the status of this service is determined. Active incidents and maintenance are applied on top.

statusModeHelp.auto: Derived from the linked monitoring checks.
statusModeHelp.manual: You set the status yourself; checks are ignored.

services.manualStatusHelp: Used as long as the service is in manual mode.

aggregationHelp.worst: The worst mapped status of any linked check wins. Best for services where every component is required.
aggregationHelp.quorum: For redundant setups: only when all checks with a critical mapping are critical, the full critical status applies; if only some fail, the service is at most "Partial outage". Warnings count at most as "Degraded".

services.checksIntro: Each linked check maps its state to a service status. OK checks never affect the status.
services.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{name}}"? Its history and links to incidents and maintenance are removed. This cannot be undone.

checkLinks.internalNotice: Check names, hosts, sources and outputs are internal. They are never shown on the public status page; customers only see the resulting service status.
checkLinks.empty: No checks linked. In automatic mode the service stays operational.
checkLinks.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, host or ID
checkLinks.moreResults: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} checks. Refine the search to see more.

preview.title: Resulting status
preview.hint: Calculated live from the current check states and your unsaved settings.
preview.manualHint: Manual mode: the selected status is used.
preview.storedHint: Calculated from the current check states and the saved configuration.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Groups structure services on the public page.
groups.publicHelp: Services of a hidden group appear without group on the public page.
groups.collapsedHelp: Visitors have to expand the group to see its services.
groups.deleteConfirm_one: Delete "{{name}}"? Its {{count}} service is kept without group.
groups.deleteConfirm_other: Delete "{{name}}"? Its {{count}} services are kept without group.
groups.deleteConfirm_zero: Delete "{{name}}"? The group contains no services.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Data center locations shown on the public map.
locations.regionHelp: Locations are grouped by region on the public page.
locations.coordinatesHelp: Decimal degrees, used for the map.
locations.statusOverrideHelp: Automatic uses the worst status of the public services at this location.
locations.publicHelp: Hidden locations are not shown on the public page.
locations.servicesHint: Assign services in the service builder.
locations.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{name}}"? Services, incidents and maintenance lose the link to it. This cannot be undone.

sources.title: Monitoring sources
sources.description: Connections to your monitoring systems. Everything here is internal.
sources.newIntro: Connect a monitoring system that is polled or pushes check results.

typeHelp.icinga2: Polls the Icinga 2 REST API; results can also be pushed.
typeHelp.uptimekuma: Polls the Uptime Kuma metrics endpoint; webhook notifications are supported too.
typeHelp.openitcockpit: Polls the openITCockpit API; results can also be pushed.
typeHelp.webhook: Receives check results pushed by any system in a generic JSON format.

sources.baseUrlHelp: Reachable from the status page server.
sources.usernameHelp: An Icinga 2 API user with read permissions on objects.
sources.secretHelpStored: A value is stored. Leave empty to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
sources.filterHelp: Optional Icinga 2 API filter to limit the imported checks.
sources.includeHostsHelp: Imports host checks in addition to service checks.
sources.verifyTlsHelp: Disable only for self-signed certificates in trusted networks.
sources.enabledHelp: Disabled sources are not polled and their checks do not affect services.
sources.webhookIntro: Webhook sources have no settings. After saving you get a push URL and a token.
sources.rotateConfirm: Create a new ingest token for "{{name}}"? The current token stops working immediately.
sources.actionUnavailable: This action is not supported by the server yet.
sources.deleteConfirm_one: Delete "{{name}}" and its {{count}} check? Services lose these check links. This cannot be undone.
sources.deleteConfirm_other: Delete "{{name}}" and its {{count}} checks? Services lose these check links. This cannot be undone.
sources.deleteConfirm_zero: Delete "{{name}}"? It has no checks yet. This cannot be undone.
sources.icingaDbUrlHelp: Read-only access to the Icinga DB database, e.g. mysql://… or postgres://…. Stored encrypted; only used for history imports.
sources.historyKumaHelp: The API key cannot read heartbeats. A login (ideally a separate account) is used for history imports only. Stored encrypted.

ingest.title: Push endpoint and token
ingest.onceWarning: The token is shown only once. Store it now; you can rotate it later if it gets lost.
ingest.tokenHidden: The ingest token is stored as a hash and cannot be shown again. Rotate it to get a new one.

hints.icinga2: Polling uses the settings of this source. For instant updates, let the bundled Icinga 2 notification script post to the ingest URL.
hints.uptimekuma: In Uptime Kuma, add a notification of type "Webhook" with the ingest URL and apply it to your monitors.
hints.openitcockpit: Polling uses the settings of this source. For instant updates, configure the bundled notification command to post to the ingest URL.
hints.webhook: POST JSON like {"checks":[{"id":"web-1","name":"HTTPS","state":"ok"}]} to the ingest URL.

ingest.authHint: Authenticate with the header "Authorization: Bearer <token>" or the query parameter ?token= when headers are not supported.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: All checks reported by your monitoring sources.
checks.deleteConfirm_one: Delete "{{name}}"? It is linked to {{count}} service. A source that still reports it will create it again.
checks.deleteConfirm_other: Delete "{{name}}"? It is linked to {{count}} services. A source that still reports it will create it again.
checks.deleteConfirm_zero: Delete "{{name}}"? It is not linked to any service. A source that still reports it will create it again.

bundles.title: Check bundles
bundles.description: Combine checks of several monitoring sources (for example Uptime Kuma instances in different places) into one check. Each node has a number of votes; the bundle is down only when more than half of the votes of the reporting nodes say so.
bundles.empty: No check bundles yet. Create one to let several monitoring nodes vote on the state of a target.
bundles.deleteConfirm_one: Delete "{{name}}"? Its check is removed from {{count}} service. This cannot be undone.
bundles.deleteConfirm_other: Delete "{{name}}"? Its check is removed from {{count}} services. This cannot be undone.
bundles.sourceInfo: This source is created automatically and holds one check per check bundle. Its states are computed from the votes of the bundle members, so there is nothing to configure, poll or push here.
bundles.voteSummary: {{down}} of {{reporting}} reporting votes down, {{warning}} warning ({{total}} votes in total).
bundles.noneReporting: No member is reporting ({{total}} votes in total): the state is unknown.
bundles.usedBy_one: Linked to {{count}} service. Link the bundle check in the service editor like any other check.
bundles.usedBy_other: Linked to {{count}} services. Link the bundle check in the service editor like any other check.
bundles.noMembers: This bundle has no members yet.
bundles.nameHelp: Internal name. The bundle appears under this name in check lists and in the service editor.
bundles.membersHelp: Pick per node (monitoring source) the check that watches the target, and set its votes (whole number, at least 1). Nodes that do not report (source disabled, last poll failed, state unknown or result too old) are left out of the vote.
bundles.noCandidates: No monitoring sources of this type. Choose another source type or add a source first.
bundles.hiddenMembers_one: {{count}} selected check belongs to a source hidden by the filter; it stays in the bundle.
bundles.hiddenMembers_other: {{count}} selected checks belong to sources hidden by the filter; they stay in the bundle.
bundles.majorityNone: Add members to see when the bundle reports an outage.
bundles.majorityHint: The bundle is down when more than half of the reporting votes say so. With all nodes reporting: at least {{needed}} of {{total}} votes.
bundles.pickAnother: Add another check of this node
bundles.sourceHasNoChecks: This source has no checks yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Branding and behaviour of the public status page.

fields.utmEnabled: Append UTM parameters to outbound links
fields.analyticsRespectDnt: Respect Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control
fields.analyticsForwardIp: Pass visitors' IP addresses to Umami

settings.supportUrlHelp: Optional link to your support or contact page.
settings.defaultLocaleHelp: Used when the visitor's browser language is not available.
settings.showUptimeHelp: Shows uptime bars and percentages for services.
settings.showLocationsHelp: Shows the locations page and map.
settings.uptimeDaysHelp: Number of days in the uptime bars (7–180).
settings.recentIncidentDaysHelp: How long resolved incidents stay on the overview (1–90 days).
settings.emailSubscriptionsHelp: Visitors can subscribe to incidents and maintenance by email (double opt-in). Only offered when a mail transport is configured.
settings.maintenanceReminderHoursHelp: Reminds subscribers this many hours before scheduled maintenance; 0 turns reminders off (0–168).
settings.legalHelp: Links to your legal pages on your website, shown in the footer. A link without URL is hidden.
settings.legalLabelHelp: Optional. Empty: "{{label}}" in the visitor's language.
settings.copyrightHelp: Plain text; {year} becomes the current year. Empty: "© <year> <site name>".
settings.brandUrlHelp: Optional. Turns the copyright notice into a link to your website.
settings.showPoweredByHelp: Shows the attribution line in the footer.
settings.infoLinkHelp: Optional extra entry in the navigation, e.g. "What does the status mean?". An http(s) URL or a path on this site starting with a single / (like /about).
settings.infoLinkLabelHelp: Optional. Empty: "{{label}}" in the visitor's language.
settings.utmHelp: Adds these parameters to the links you configured that lead to other websites (footer, info link, service websites). Links on this site, mailto: links and links that already carry utm_ parameters stay unchanged.
settings.analyticsHelp: Loads the Umami tracker on the public pages through this server (/pulse/), never from the Umami server itself. It only runs when the instance that serves the public pages has UMAMI_URL set. Visitors can turn it off in the footer; subscription links are never tracked.
settings.analyticsUnavailable: This server has no UMAMI_URL, so the switch has no effect here. Page views are only counted by instances that have it: set UMAMI_URL on every instance that serves the public pages, this one included.
settings.analyticsWebsiteIdHelp: The UUID Umami shows for the website (Settings → Websites). Required when analytics is on.
settings.analyticsDomainsHelp: Host names separated by commas, e.g. status.example.com. Empty: every host name the page is opened under.
settings.analyticsRespectDntHelp: Sends nothing for visitors whose browser asks not to be tracked.
settings.analyticsForwardIpHelp: Off by default: Umami then sees this server instead of the visitor, so it shows no visitor locations and counts visitors with the same browser version as one. Turn it on only if your privacy policy covers it.

users.title: Users
users.description: People who can sign in to the management area.
users.roleHelp: Editors manage incidents and maintenance; administrators manage everything.
users.ownRoleHelp: You cannot change your own role.
users.passwordOptionalHelp: At least 10 characters. Leave empty for single sign-on only accounts.
users.newPasswordHelp: Leave empty to keep the current password. Setting a new one signs the user out everywhere and revokes their API tokens.
users.removePasswordHelp: The user can then only sign in with single sign-on.
users.oidcLinkedHelp: This account is linked to a single sign-on identity.
users.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}} ({{email}})? The user is signed out immediately.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.description: Tokens for scripts and integrations that use the admin API.
tokens.nameHelp: Describe where the token is used.
tokens.roleHelp: Permissions of the token, like a user with this role.
tokens.onceWarning: The token is shown only once. Store it in a safe place now.
tokens.usage: Send it as a bearer token:
tokens.revokeConfirm: Revoke "{{name}}"? Integrations using it stop working immediately.

privatePages.title: Private pages
privatePages.description: Status pages with a secret link for chosen services, also ones hidden from the public page. Not indexed by search engines.
privatePages.regenerated: New link created. The old link no longer works.
privatePages.nameHelp: Shown as the title of the page.
privatePages.servicesHelp: Any service, also ones hidden from the public page.
privatePages.expiresAtHelp: Optional. The link stops working at this time.
privatePages.enabledHelp: A disabled page answers like an unknown link.
privatePages.onceWarning: The link is shown only once. Copy it now and share it only with the people who should see the page.
privatePages.regenerateConfirm: Create a new link for "{{name}}"? The current link stops working immediately.
privatePages.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{name}}"? Its link stops working immediately.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every change made in the management area or through the API.

notify.label: Notify subscribers
notify.incidentHelp: Emails this incident to subscribers of the affected services and of all updates.
notify.updateHelp: Emails this update to subscribers of the affected services and of all updates.
notify.maintenanceHelp: Emails the announcement and enables the reminder and the automatic start and completion emails.
notify.maintenanceEditHelp: Enables the reminder and the automatic start and completion emails. Saving does not send an email.
notify.enabledHint: Emails are only sent when email subscriptions are enabled in the settings.

notifications.title: Email delivery
notifications.noTransportWarning: Email subscriptions are enabled, but no mail transport is configured, so the public page does not offer them. Set SMTP_HOST (or MAIL_TRANSPORT) in the server environment.
notifications.noTransport: No mail transport is configured. Set SMTP_HOST and SMTP_FROM in the server environment, or MAIL_TRANSPORT=log for development.
notifications.logTransport: Emails are written to the server log instead of being delivered (development mode).
notifications.testWrittenToLog: Test email written to the server log
notifications.testFailed: The test email could not be sent.

subscribers.title: Subscribers
subscribers.description: People who receive incident and maintenance emails. Unconfirmed subscriptions are removed automatically after 7 days.
subscribers.empty: No subscribers yet. Visitors can subscribe on the public page once email subscriptions are enabled.
subscribers.deleteConfirm: Delete {{email}}? The address receives no further emails and queued emails are dropped. This cannot be undone.

historyImport.title: History import
historyImport.cardHelp: Fill the uptime history for the time before the status page recorded data.
historyImport.intro: Reads the check history of the source for a time range and shows a preview. Nothing is changed before you confirm.
historyImport.totpHelp: Only when the account uses two-factor authentication: the current 6-digit code.
historyImport.kumaHelp: Uptime Kuma only returns heartbeats to a logged-in user. A login entered here is only used for this import and is not stored.
historyImport.storedUsed: Leave empty to use the value stored in the source.
historyImport.notStored: Used for this import only, not stored.
historyImport.databaseUrlHelp: Read-only database user, e.g. mysql://reader:secret@db.example.com:3306/icingadb. Used for this import only.
historyImport.oitcHelp: Uses the API key of the source. Set the time zone of the API user to UTC.
historyImport.csvHelp: Columns: check (external ID) or service (slug), start, end, state. Times in ISO 8601 with time zone. Up to 5 MB.
historyImport.csvTooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB.

csvIssues.unterminated_quote: a quoted field is not closed
csvIssues.timestamp_format: start and end must be ISO 8601 timestamps with time zone, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z
csvIssues.check_state: state must be one of {{allowed}} for check rows
csvIssues.service_status: state must be one of {{allowed}} for service rows
csvIssues.overlap_check: overlaps line {{other}} of the same check
csvIssues.overlap_service: overlaps line {{other}} of the same service

historyImport.onlyLinked: Only checks used by services or bundles
historyImport.onlyLinkedHelp: Fewer requests; other checks get no history.
historyImport.gapsOnly: Only periods without recorded history are filled. Recorded history is never changed; earlier imports of the same period are replaced.
historyImport.backgroundHint: The import runs on the server. You can close this dialog and come back later.
historyImport.previewSummary: From {{from}} to {{to}}: history for {{checks}} checks; {{services}} services get uptime data.
historyImport.noServices: No service uses the imported checks.
historyImport.noChecks: No history found for the checks of this source.
historyImport.unmatched_one: {{count}} entry matches no check of this source
historyImport.unmatched_other: {{count}} entries match no check of this source
historyImport.applyHint: Importing writes the history shown here. The public uptime bars change accordingly.
historyImport.completed: Imported: {{intervals}} check intervals, {{segments}} status segments for {{services}} services.
historyImport.failed: The import failed. Nothing was changed.

warning.kuma_retention: Uptime Kuma returned heartbeats from {{earliest}} on only. Older data was removed by its retention ("Keep monitor history data", default 180 days).
warning.kuma_duplicate_name: Several Uptime Kuma monitors are named "{{name}}"; skipped.
warning.kuma_monitor_failed: The heartbeats of "{{name}}" could not be read and were skipped (e.g. too many for one response: choose a shorter range or reduce the retention in Uptime Kuma). Details: {{reason}}
warning.oitc_utc: openITCockpit times without a time zone were read as UTC (set the API user's time zone to UTC).

error.source: The monitoring system or the file reported an error: {{message}}
error.timeout: The import took too long and was stopped. Choose a shorter range.
error.shutdown: The import was interrupted by a server shutdown.
error.interrupted: The import was interrupted (e.g. by a restart).
error.expired: The preview expired without being imported.
